title: AWS SDK for .NET
description: Install AWS SDK packages in an ASP.NET Core project and make your first AWS SDK call.

data.text: The AWS SDK for .NET is distributed as NuGet packages. Each AWS service has its own package, and they follow common conventions for authentication, retries, and async APIs.

data.title: Install S3 and Secrets Manager packages
data.content: Use the dotnet CLI or Package Manager Console to add AWS SDK packages.
data.code:
dotnet add package AWSSDK.S3
dotnet add package AWSSDK.SecretsManager
dotnet add package AWSSDK.Core

data.text: The AWS SDK uses a credential chain. When you do not specify credentials explicitly, it checks environment variables, the AWS credentials file, EC2/ECS IAM roles, and other sources in order.

data.title: Authenticate with the default credential chain
data.content: This approach works locally and in AWS without code changes.

data.title: Local development flow
data.text: When running locally, the AWS SDK uses the credentials from `aws configure` or environment variables. When deployed to EC2, ECS, or Lambda, it can use an IAM role automatically.
Create a Reusable AWS Client Factory
In ASP.NET Core, register AWS clients in `Program.cs` so they are available through dependency injection.

data.title: Register AWS clients in Program.cs
data.content: Use the AWS SDK extensions to register typed clients for DI.

data.title: Add AWS SDK to a web app
data.description: Create a new ASP.NET Core app and add the AWS SDK packages.
steps: Run the `dotnet add package` commands shown above
Add the AWS service registration code in `Program.cs`
Set the AWS region in `appsettings.json` or environment variables
Run the app and verify it starts without errors
data.expectedOutcome: The app starts successfully and the AWS clients are registered in the DI container.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: AWS SDK packages are distributed through NuGet
The default credential chain removes the need for hardcoded keys
`AddAWSService` in ASP.NET Core centralizes AWS client registration
Prefer `async` APIs for all AWS service calls
data.takeaway: Once the SDK packages and credential strategy are in place, the rest of the course focuses on using individual AWS services from C#.
